(3) There was no way to pass a gaze pair to the decoder. Added a GazeSourcing input point; nil keeps decode(gaze: nil).
(4) A failed model step left the loop changed: the memory check came after step, executedCommand and fingerGoals were already updated. The loop now saves that state only after every check passes.
